name: Total Amount And Currency 1
definition: Set of elements providing the total amount of all operations.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total net amount for all operations taken into account in the report.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the total amount is a credit or a debit amount.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency in which the total amount is expressed.
